title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo on 1989-08-06
lineage: Fostex D-5 (AES/BU)> Luminous Monarch cable>(s/pdif) M-Audio Audiophile 2496> Audacity @ 16/48> 16/44> CDWAve(tracking)> TLH (SBE's/Flac/md5); the original version of this source had a flaw in set2t02; please do not circulate that version
source: FOB/Schoeps CMC 44's> Oade p/s> SV-255 by Ted Mattes. DAT clone provided by Lance Deal;

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience recording of a beautiful show, praised for crystal‑clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gush about the performance, calling it a "beautiful show" and highlighting the audio as one of the best audience sources they’ve heard. The FLAC capture is described as clear and vivid, making this 1989 concert highly enjoyable despite the lack of detailed song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are enthusiastic; one gives a solid 4‑star rating and the other offers no star but praises sound and performance, indicating a strong show with excellent audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note beautiful, crystal‑clear audio for an audience tape; described as the "best Aud source" and a "beautiful sound" capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply emphasize the overall beauty of the performance.
